description: The file 'bisect.c' contains implementation for git bisect functionality, including algorithms for binary search over commits, handling references, and managing bisect state and process flow.

methods.name: int count_distance(struct commit_list * entry)
methods.description: Computes the distance of commits in a list from interest; used in bisection algorithm.

methods.name: void clear_distance(struct commit_list * list)
methods.description: Resets the COUNTED flag on commits in a list, clearing distance calculations.

methods.name: int weight(struct commit_list * elem)
methods.description: Returns the weight (distance metric) of a commit list element.

methods.name: void weight_set(struct commit_list * elem,int weight)
methods.description: Sets the weight (distance measure) for a commit list element.

methods.name: int count_interesting_parents(struct commit * commit,unsigned bisect_flags)
methods.description: Counts the number of interesting parent commits for a given commit, used for bisect traversal.

methods.name: int approx_halfway(struct commit_list * p,int nr)
methods.description: Determines if a commit is approximately halfway in the search space for bisecting purposes.

methods.name: void show_list(const char * debug,int counted,int nr,struct commit_list * list)
methods.description: Debug utility to print a list of commits with their flags and other info.

methods.name: struct:commit_list * best_bisection(struct commit_list * list,int nr)
methods.description: Selects the commit node that is most balanced in bisect search based on weight.

methods.name: int compare_commit_dist(const void * a_,const void * b_)
methods.description: Comparator for sorting commits by their distance metric for bisect efficiency.

methods.name: struct:commit_list * best_bisection_sorted(struct commit_list * list,int nr)
methods.description: Selects best bisection points with sorted commit array for more precise bisect operation.

methods.name: struct:commit_list * do_find_bisection(struct commit_list * list,int nr,int * weights,unsigned bisect_flags)
methods.description: Core algorithm to find the appropriate commit for bisecting, based on commit weights and distances.

methods.name: void find_bisection(struct commit_list ** commit_list,int * reaches,int * all,unsigned bisect_flags)
methods.description: Main entry to perform bisect search across a commit list, initializing weights and selecting bisect point.

methods.name: int register_ref(const struct reference * ref,void * cb_data UNUSED)
methods.description: Registers references related to bisect, such as 'good', 'bad', and 'skip' markers.

methods.name: int read_bisect_refs(void)
methods.description: Reads bisect-related references from repository refs.

methods.name: read_bisect_paths(struct strvec * array)
methods.description: Reads specific path files related to bisect configuration.

methods.name: char * join_oid_array_hex(struct oid_array * array,char delim)
methods.description: Creates a concatenated hex string of OIDs in an array with a delimiter.

methods.name: struct:commit_list * filter_skipped(struct commit_list * list,struct commit_list ** tried,int show_all,int * count,int * skipped_first)
methods.description: Filters a list of commits to exclude or include skipped ones based on user parameters.

methods.name: struct:commit_list * skip_away(struct commit_list * list,int count)
methods.description: Randomly skips away a subset of commits for bisecting.

methods.name: struct:commit_list * managed_skipped(struct commit_list * list,struct commit_list ** tried)
methods.description: Filters and skips commits in a list according to skip list.

methods.name: void bisect_rev_setup(struct repository * r,struct rev_info * revs,struct strvec * rev_argv,const char * prefix,const char * bad_format,const char * good_format,int read_paths)
methods.description: Sets up revision arguments for bisect operations, including good/bad commits and paths.

methods.name: void bisect_common(struct rev_info * revs)
methods.description: Common setup for bisect operations, including revision walking and marking uninteresting commits.

methods.name: enum:bisect_error error_if_skipped_commits(struct commit_list * tried,const struct object_id * bad)
methods.description: Checks if only skipped commits remain, indicating the bisect cannot proceed, and reports errors.

methods.name: int is_expected_rev(const struct object_id * oid)
methods.description: Checks if an OID matches the expected revision in bisect context.

methods.name: enum:bisect_error bisect_checkout(const struct object_id * bisect_rev,int no_checkout)
methods.description: Checks out a specific commit for bisect testing, updating references and printing commit info.

methods.name: struct:commit * get_commit_reference(struct repository * r,const struct object_id * oid)
methods.description: Finds and returns a commit object from repository given an OID.

methods.name: struct:commit ** get_bad_and_good_commits(struct repository * r,size_t * rev_nr)
methods.description: Collects commit pointers for 'bad' and 'good' revisions for bisect purposes.

methods.name: enum:bisect_error handle_bad_merge_base(void)
methods.description: Handles the scenario where the merge base is unexpectedly 'bad' or 'new'.

methods.name: void handle_skipped_merge_base(const struct object_id * mb)
methods.description: Warns when merge bases must be skipped in bisect, complicating the process.

methods.name: enum:bisect_error check_merge_bases(size_t rev_nr,struct commit ** rev,int no_checkout)
methods.description: Checks merge bases for their status and whether they need testing.

methods.name: int check_ancestors(struct repository * r,size_t rev_nr,struct commit ** rev,const char * prefix)
methods.description: Verifies whether all revisions are ancestors of the 'bad' commit.

methods.name: enum:bisect_error check_good_are_ancestors_of_bad(struct repository * r,const char * prefix,int no_checkout)
methods.description: Ensures all good revisions are ancestors of the bad revision before starting bisect.

methods.name: void show_commit(struct commit * commit)
methods.description: Displays detailed commit information to the user.

methods.name: void read_bisect_terms(char ** read_bad,char ** read_good)
methods.description: Reads user-defined terms for 'bad'/'good' from configuration.

methods.name: enum:bisect_error bisect_next_all(struct repository * r,const char * prefix)
methods.description: Main control function that performs a bisect step, choosing the next commit to test.

methods.name: int exp2i(int n)
methods.description: Computes 2 raised to the power n, used in bisect step estimation.

methods.name: int estimate_bisect_steps(int all)
methods.description: Estimates how many steps are left in the bisect process.

methods.name: int mark_for_removal(const struct reference * ref,void * cb_data)
methods.description: Marks references for removal during cleanup.

methods.name: int bisect_clean_state(void)
methods.description: Removes all bisect state and references, cleaning repository state for a fresh start.

methods.name: unsigned get_prn(unsigned count)
methods.description: unavailable

methods.name: int sqrti(int val)
methods.description: unavailable
